title: Package deployment bundle, include smoke tests, prepare PEN payload, classify evidence

insert_test_events: insert synthetic t4h_event rows for assessment_completed, results_viewed, content_completed, action_completed, vault_saved
validate_views: select * from public.v_config_thresholds_effective order by threshold_group, threshold_key;
select * from public.t4h_feature_daily order by feature_date desc limit 20;

execution_steps: Assemble bundle tree exactly as specified
Run SQL files in numbered order against Supabase dev
Load seed CSVs into matching tables
Run smoke tests in smoke_tests order
Capture SQL outputs and object counts
Write receipt under receipts/runtime/ with execution result and evidence classification
If any step fails, write REAL failure receipt with exact error and stop before pretending success

evidence_classification.bundle_artifacts: PARTIAL until worker materialises bundle in repo/artifact store
evidence_classification.supabase_runtime: PARTIAL until SQL execution receipt exists
evidence_classification.telemetry_proof: PARTIAL until synthetic event + rollup output exists

definition_of_done: Bundle files exist in repo/artifact store
Supabase objects created or real failure captured
Seed rows loaded or real failure captured
